prompt:
Create a polished native iPhone UI concept board titled "Cuekeeper — Combined Glass". Four equal portrait screenshots side by side: Upcoming light, Upcoming dark, job detail light, Payments dark. No device hardware. Reference 1 is the Quiet Glass base: preserve its SF Pro typography, stacked cue-card logo, forest/mint/ivory/charcoal palette, date rails, flat readable content and subtle floating tab bar. Reference 2 supplies ONLY the rounded pill Add Job and circular plus/action buttons with delicate translucent glass rims. Keep shine confined to actionable buttons. Status badges, financial panels and segmented filters MUST stay matte, without glass rims or glow. Tab bar stays quiet as reference 1, not bright like reference 2.
Upcoming: October 2026; display only a compact "All upcoming" dropdown instead of This week segmented filter. Rows WED 14 Courtside Live / Independent Production / Booked / Schedule to come; FRI 16 Weekend Preview / Metro Sports Network / Tentative / Oct 16–17; MON 19 Studio Roundup / Riverton Media / Booked / Schedule to come. Header Add Job is a softly highlighted glass pill. Bottom tabs Upcoming, Jobs, Payments, Settings.
Detail: native Jobs back, rounded Edit action; Northside vs. City / Booked / Oct 12, 2026 / Fieldhouse Sports / Commentator · Remote. Sessions: Match coverage, 18:00–20:30 ET, Confirmed · Covering, Call 17:30. Broadcast links: Add link. Fee: $800 USD · Agreed. Invoice: Not invoiced. Rounded Mark completed action and circular ellipsis. Fit readable visible excerpt.
Payments: circular glass plus; understated flat Outstanding balances section, USD $2,400 and EUR €900 separate; FS-104 Fieldhouse Sports $800 remaining Part paid; MS-028 Metro Sports Network $1,600 remaining Unpaid; RV-012 Riverton Media €900 remaining Unpaid. Unpaid badges neutral muted grey, not red. No shiny balance tiles. Footer "Concept exploration · Fictional demo data". Crisp text, restrained native elegance, no ornamental background blobs.
direction: User requested Quiet Glass base, expressive sidebar, rounded action buttons
approval: User requested: implement this redesign, referring to the Combined Glass design.
